verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs have an "API and MCP" section. It documents scoped service keys "for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace", plus an OAuth-connected official MCP server, so programmatic and agent access is documented. However, the evidence never shows an actual public API reference, such as endpoints, resources or request formats. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the docs site returned 404. Missing for 10: an evidenced public API reference with endpoints and supported operations, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the API can drive the product.
